name: resonance
title: Resonance
description: Search, play and discover Commodore 64 SID music in Resonance, by title, composer, mood or how a tune sounds.
author: erikluimes

commands.name: search-tunes
commands.title: Search Tunes
commands.description: Find tunes by title or composer, and see how each one sounds.

commands.name: sounds-like
commands.title: Sounds Like This
commands.description: Find tunes that sound like the one playing.

commands.name: describe
commands.title: Describe Sound
commands.description: Make a list from words, such as fast arpeggios from 1987.

commands.name: now-playing
commands.title: Now Playing
commands.description: See the tune playing, how it sounds, and control it.

commands.name: playlists
commands.title: Playlists
commands.description: Open and play Favourites and your playlists.

commands.name: recently-played
commands.title: Recently Played
commands.description: Go back to a tune you played.

commands.name: previous-tune
commands.title: Previous Tune
commands.description: Go back to the previous tune.

commands.name: surprise-me
commands.title: Surprise Me
commands.description: Play something from the collection you may not know.

commands.name: favourite-tune
commands.title: Favourite Tune
commands.description: Add the tune playing to Favourites, or take it out.
